<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex9042024-09-1712-48-21" status="finalized">
            <milestone unit="section" n="212.3 bsgyur ba (2a4–2a5)"/>
         bsgyur ba ni shan sbyar ba las <choice><orig>‹'›thob</orig><reg>'thob</reg></choice> ste | <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">a rya</foreign> na 'phags pa'o || <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">sa rba</foreign> na <abbr>thams cad</abbr> do || 
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">a sti bA da</foreign> na yod par smra ba'o ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">shra ma Ne ra</foreign> na dge tshul <lb n="2a5"/> lo || <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">ka ri ka</foreign> na tshig le'ur byas pa'o ||<note type="editorial">The text being commented upon is identified here as having the Sanskrit title Ārya-sarva-astivādi-śrāmaṇera-kārikā, in Tibetan: 'Phags pa thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa</note></seg></TEI>
